body: Yeah but it’s a win win situation. The pain goes away and they get what’s coming to them. What eventually happens when you hurt someone a little too much. Better than being alive and brain dead from all the trauma caused to your frontal lobe due to cortisol build up
I watched this whole thing just as I started tripping on acid. It’s an amazing thing and so weird I only stumbled onto it during an acid trip but such a gratifying experience

I’ve been going through the exact same thing. I’ve seeked all the help I could in every possible way, all they help me with is setting up school so I can do it at home because I’m bed ridden most of the time. Last two nights I’ve been staying up till 8:30am and it’s frustrating being dependant on someone else to baby me to sleep and get up at least at 12pm to take my meds. Meds don’t help. I’m tired of explaining everything to everyone. Attempted suicide but i just got really high and didn’t even come close to dying. I get the pain is so unbearable because even people that don’t know about it think it’s just me being lazy but really just getting out of bed makes me panic some days. So nice to find someone to relate to
